title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Duo #03 (부채꼴·매끈 / 가로 띠·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: French, in her mid 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of mixed-metal a bracelet. Painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 48% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 6 o'clock, 9 o'clock and 1 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with optical illusion grid filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 1 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with fine filigree linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 1 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst), wide silver chrome bands following the contours of the body, with zigzag linework filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Vietnamese, in her mid 30s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her upper silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward just as prominently, the bust and the belly together forming the two dominant curves of her frame. Round hips and soft thighs continue below. Her head looks small between her massive bust and belly. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real pores, real living eyes, 50 clicker rings piercings set with diamonds in copper-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of silver earrings. Painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 46% of the way down her figure from the top and about 78% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with stepped geometric borders filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following the contours of the body, with repeating floral border filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, with spiral resist motifs filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
